sentences.text: Istiyak Alam vs Unknown on 11 January, 2024

Item No.307ML CHC Rejected C.R.M.(A) 4982 of 2023 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Para P o l i c e S t a t i o n C a s e N o . 1 0 / 2 0 1 3 d a t e d 0 1 . 0 3 . 2 0 1 3 u n d e r S e c t i o n s 147/148/149/498A/323/307/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
And In the matter of : Istiyak Alam ...... petitioner Ms. Mitali Jana ....for the petitioner Mr. Partha Pratim Das, Ms. M. Roy ....for the State Petitioner prays for anticipatory bail.
The police case is dated March 1, 2013.
In view of the long absconsion of the petitioner, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
The application for anticipatory bail is rejected.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
